description:
Activate Reckoner Bankbuster by paying {2}, tapping it, and removing a charge counter from it, drawing a card, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
When the Pilot enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priority, if Reckoner Bankbuster is not a creature, activate its crew ability by tapping the Pilot, causing Reckoner Bankbuster to become an artifact creatures until end of turn.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Reckoner Bankbuster.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Reckoner Bankbuster
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with exactly one charge counter on it
